# kool-regen

This is the tool I type at a terminal to bring a project's containers up, reach inside them, and ship the result somewhere. Most of its everyday actions now give wrong answers, a few fail outright, and in several places a feature's close neighbour still behaves perfectly, which makes the whole thing confusing to use. The repository has received 30 separate undocumented edits. Everything below is what I could observe from the outside, without reading the source.

The first thing I notice is that what I type turns into a different invocation than it used to. Bringing the project up with no options at all now hands the underlying tool an unexpected extra flag ahead of the detach flag it used to lead with, and asking to stay attached to my terminal, which ought to hand down no extra flags whatsoever, still hands several down. Asking for a fresh build of the images while bringing things up pulls them and then never performs the build step that should follow. Tearing everything down while asking for a full wipe no longer hands down the pair of extra arguments it used to, the one asking for orphans to be removed followed by the one asking for stored data to be removed; what arrives is a different list. Launching a throwaway container while setting a variable through the dedicated option sends an argument list that is no longer the four-element list it used to be, and that option together with its key=value no longer sits at the front of it.
